meta.indexDescription: Thirteen benches on a six-month robotics roadmap: build each board part by part, power it up, break it on purpose and fix it, from Ohm's law to a ROS 2 robot brain.

index.title: Build it, power it, break it, fix it
index.lede: Thirteen hand-inked benches in the order of a six-month robotics roadmap. Each one walks you through the build, lets you cause the failures that catch real builders, and ends with practice tasks you check by running code and a short quiz.
index.progressLabel: {done} of {total} steps, tasks and quizzes done
index.ownSupply: No controller: the bench runs from its own supply

months.m5: Month 5 · power and the ROS 2 brain

uno-r3-build.name: Arduino Uno R3
uno-r3-build.teaches: Meet the board: build it from a bare PCB, reflow the SMD parts, solder the through-hole parts, upload a sketch and break it on purpose.

led-resistor.name: LED + resistor
led-resistor.teaches: Ohm's law with a meter: pick a resistor, predict the current, measure it, and see what a bypassed resistor or a backwards LED does.

transistor-switch.name: Transistor switch
transistor-switch.teaches: Logic drives power: one Nano pin switches a motor through a TIP120, and a flyback diode keeps the turn-off spike away from the transistor.

esp32-s3-build.name: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1
esp32-s3-build.teaches: Wi-Fi and two cores: build the dev board, light the RGB LED on GPIO38 and serve a web page from the chip.

tb6612fng.name: TB6612FNG driver
tb6612fng.teaches: A MOSFET H-bridge: direction, PWM speed, brake and standby for two DC motors from one Nano.

l298n.name: L298N driver
l298n.teaches: The classic module and why to avoid it: its bipolar switches drop around 2 V and turn it into heat, and the enable jumpers matter.

a4988.name: A4988 stepper driver
a4988.teaches: Microstepping a NEMA 17: set the current limit with Vref before the motor runs, then step, direction and 1/16 steps.

pca9685.name: PCA9685 servo board
pca9685.teaches: Sixteen PWM channels over I2C: 50 Hz servo pulses, and a separate supply for the servos' stall current.

mpu6050.name: MPU-6050 IMU
mpu6050.teaches: A gyro and an accelerometer over I2C: watch the gyro angle drift, then fuse both with a complementary filter.

hc-sr04.name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic
hc-sr04.teaches: Time of flight: a 10 µs trigger, an echo pulse, and distance = echo time × 343 m/s ÷ 2.

qtr-8rc.name: QTR-8RC line sensor
qtr-8rc.teaches: Eight reflectance sensors read by RC timing, a weighted line position and a line follower with tunable Kp and Kd.

lm2596.name: LM2596 buck module
lm2596.teaches: Power and brown-outs: turn the trimpot to set the output from a LiPo, then watch a stalled motor drag a shared rail down.

pi5-ros2.name: Raspberry Pi 5
pi5-ros2.teaches: The ROS 2 brain: the official 27 W USB-C supply (5.1 V, 5 A), the under-voltage flags, and nodes that talk over topics.
